title: Vantrilex universal capsule schema family
description: Single source of truth for every capsule shape in the P1 flows: MISSION-PLAN capsules issued by AETHER, findings capsules issued by PULSAR, refusal/escalation capsules issued by any leader, and WAKE plus OVERRIDE event records. Each definition states its required fields in its required array; every other listed property is optional. Validated by node scripts/validate-capsule.mjs, which reads this file and enforces it. Enforcement is detective only: per P1-R0 Verdict 1 (PARKED) no hook denies admission, so the plan-guard reports drift after the fact and no HARD admission-denial claim is made.

wiring.reference: Every capsule flow cites this family by path schemas/capsules/capsule.schema.json and validates with node scripts/validate-capsule.mjs.
wiring.mission_plan: The AETHER MISSION-PLAN section cites this family and validates each emitted plan before handoff.
wiring.findings: The PULSAR findings-capsule section cites this family and validates each emitted findings capsule before chaining to AETHER.
wiring.refusal: Every refusal/escalation path cites the refusal definition and validates the capsule it emits.
wiring.wake_override: The WAKE-REQUEST channel spec and the OVERRIDE log cite the wake and override definitions and validate each event record.
wiring.enforcement: Detective only. A capsule that fails validation is reported with named reasons and never silently accepted; nothing here grants a hook the power to refuse a brief.

mission-plan.description: AETHER planning output. Required: capsule, capsule_version, issued_at, issuer, plan_id, waves, handoff, plan_guard. Optional: replan_count, ledger_ref, notes.

findings.description: PULSAR exploration output, chained to AETHER only and never raw to execution. Required: capsule, capsule_version, issued_at, issuer, findings_id, hypothesis, findings, chain. Optional: budget_ref, confidence.

refusal.description: Refusal or escalation record from any leader. Required: capsule, capsule_version, issued_at, issuer, disposition, reason, refused_request. Optional: evidence, suggested_route. Disposition refuse stops the request; escalate routes it upward with the reason attached.

wake.description: WAKE-REQUEST channel event. Required: capsule, capsule_version, issued_at, issuer, channel, summary. Optional: context_ref.

override.description: OVERRIDE log record. Required: capsule, capsule_version, issued_at, issuer, owner_directive, verdict_ref, verdict_preserved. The verdict_preserved field keeps the original verdict text on record: an owner override never suppresses a verdict. Optional: rationale.
